name: Heilyn

attributes.attribute: minor Welsh hero of the Mabinogion, a survivor of Brân the Blessed's war on Ireland
opened the magic door through which the surviving warriors escaped

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Heilyn is a minor Welsh hero. He fought in the Welsh epic the Mabinogion. Brân the Blessed waged a fierce war on Ireland in that tale. Only a few warriors survived the battles. Heilyn was one of them. He opened the magic door through which the survivors escaped.

okr.objective: Document Heilyn, the minor Welsh hero who opened the escape door.
key_results: Record his place in the Mabinogion.
Describe the war of Brân the Blessed on Ireland.
Note that Heilyn opened the magic door for the survivors.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Heilyn entry.
